coaching.headline: An eight-tower stomp with one leak: the duo died four times before 8.2, all to Revenant and Steel.
coaching.team: We took every Fangtooth, the Genesis Core, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth, and eight towers to one; 66,030 objective damage to their 8,776 is the whole story. The leak was the duo lane. Kira and Maco died four times before 8.2, every one to Revenant or Steel, including the fight at 6.9 lost 0-2 at our own Fangtooth with Scarlett and Renna both alive and ahead. The same two died 0-2 to the same two again at 15.5, deep in our jungle with nothing up. Everything else was clean: Aurora ran the jungle against Khaimera, 20,984 objective damage against their whole side's 8,776, and their mid Wraith finished 0-6-0 with one item. Nine fights won, six cashed. They took the river, 13 to 8, and a Mini Prime at 13 with nobody dead on our side. Next game: the duo does not take a 2v2 against Revenant and Steel without the jungler; twice was the pattern.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The fight at 8.2, won 3-1 at our outer tower with four of ours in it, was the fix for 6.9: the duo stopped fighting 2v2 and the tower fell to us right after. From there the map was ours: Fangtooth, Genesis Core, Orb Prime, Primal Fangtooth.
coaching.whatWorked: Aurora's jungle: 7 kills on 2 deaths, 20,984 objective damage against their whole side's 8,776, and Tainted Guard's anti-heal against Khaimera's 16,127 self-healing.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira did the damage and gave the enemy duo four kills. 43,385 hero damage and 30,876 objective damage, both the most in the game, 9 kills, six of them on Revenant. Four deaths, three to Revenant and one to Steel, two of them in 2v2s with Maco lost 0-2 at 6.9 and 15.5. Three items at 27 minutes.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco healed the game and died early twice. 23,948 healing, the most in the game, 6 kills and 11 assists, first blood on Revenant at 2.4. Deaths to Revenant at 4.3 and Steel before minute 10, then the 2v2 at 15.5 with nothing up.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett won the offlane and stayed alive. 4 kills, three of them on Shinbi, 2 deaths, 8 wards. Part of the fight at 23.1 at our Orb Prime, won 3-0, that turned into Orb Prime. Alive and ahead when the duo died at 6.9, the fight that needed a third body. No armor against three physical damage dealers.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna carried the mid-game fights and got caught once. 7 kills, 8 assists, 29,624 hero damage, in the fights at 18.8 and 23.1, won 4-0 and 3-0. The solo death to Khaimera at 17.8 was our only death caught outside a fight. 4 wards, fewest on the team.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Aurora ran the jungle. 7 kills, 2 deaths, 9 assists, 20,984 objective damage against their whole side's 8,776, and Tainted Guard as the anti-heal into Khaimera's 16,127 self-healing. No kill or death credited in the fight at 6.9 the duo lost 0-2, with the jungle reading ours early; from 14.4 on, in six of the won fights.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Most hero and objective damage in the game, and four deaths to the same duo, three of them to Revenant.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: Most healing in the game, 23,948, with 6 kills and 11 assists; two deaths before minute 10 is the fix.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.text: Four kills, three of them on Shinbi, on two deaths in a won offlane; nothing to fix here.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Seven kills and the fights at 18.8 and 23.1, but a solo death for the third film in a row.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Seven kills on two deaths and 20,984 objective damage: the jungle was won.

6.9.call: Kira and Maco fought Revenant and Steel 2v2 at our own Fangtooth and lost 0-2 with Scarlett and Renna alive and ahead. After taking the Fangtooth, the duo backs off or the jungler stays; a 2v2 there is a coin-flip.

8.2.call: Four of ours met Wraith, Revenant and Shinbi at our outer tower and won 3-1, and the tower fell to us right after. This is the answer to 6.9: bodies, not bravery.

15.5.call: Kira and Maco died 0-2 to Steel and Revenant deep in our jungle with nothing up, the second time the same two lost to the same two. A bad trade: reset, ward, wait for Renna, alive and ahead in lane.

18.8.call: Renna, Maco and Aurora went 4-0 at our Fangtooth and an outer tower followed. The fight was taken on top of our objective with the jungler in it; that is what 6.9 and 15.5 were missing.

21.5.call: Renna and Kira went 2-0 at our inner tower and nothing was taken in the next 90 seconds. The call: walk to Orb Prime as five straight off it; it came at 23 anyway, late.

23.1.call: Renna and Scarlett went 3-0 on Revenant, Wraith and Shinbi at our Orb Prime, and Orb Prime plus an inner tower followed inside two minutes. Two of ours credited against three of theirs; the follow-up is the lesson: take the objective, then the tower.

26.4.call: Won 4-1 at their inhibitor, three items up on the count, 12 to 9, and the inhibitor and core fell inside a minute. Right fight, right place; the game ended because the team pushed as five.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Three items at 27 minutes on 43,385 damage is the read: Tainted Rounds and Ruination instead of Solaris and Ashbringer traded the core's heal-back hit and cooldown refunds for anti-heal and mana burn, and against a lineup with no healer only Khaimera's 16,127 self-heal needed it.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Kira's stack-and-shred kit into a Revenant who kept diving her, and trades away Demiurge's item scaling.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Two of the three core items, with Everbloom in Enra's Blessing's slot and Tainted Totem as a third anti-heal against a lineup with no healer; the deaths at 4.3 and 7.1 came before any of it was online (Crescelia estimated minute 12), so items did not decide them.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Maco.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Syonic Echo, Overlord, Aegis Of Agawar and Terminus with no armor against three physical damage dealers, and two deaths say the game never tested it.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Thraex marks the last hero Scarlett hit for more damage dealt and less taken, the duelist fit for an offlane that killed Shinbi three times, and gives up Krix's raw health.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: On the full Entropy, Wraith Leggings, Overseer core with Oblivion Crown fourth; nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, the fit for a mage whose kit is zones and waves, at the cost of any durability against Revenant's 29,845 physical damage.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Tainted Guard and Flux Matrix in the Elafrost and Gaia Greaves slots was the right swap: Tainted Guard's anti-heal is the answer to Khaimera's 16,127 self-healing, and the jungle finished 7 kills on 2 deaths; nothing to fix here.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, which fits a jungler whose kit is a chain of frost abilities, and gives up the raw health Krix would add to a tank that took 40,249 damage.

synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
ourKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak
